description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Draft" name="Tree house draft"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Materials order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderComplete" name="Materials order processed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="Tree house party invitation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_BuildingHouse"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements" name="Send requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Return draft"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedDraft" name="Return revised draft"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order materials"
                      sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Stores"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderComplete" name="Materials order processed"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Stores" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"
                      messageRef="Message_OrderComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Ask friends to build the house"
                      sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send party invitations"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"
                      messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildingHouse" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_BuildingHouse">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_WantToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PlanReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefinePlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAdditionalRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskFriendsToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_WantToBuild" name="Want to build a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to architect"
                   messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlanReady" name="Is the plan ready?"
                           default="Flow_PlanReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePlan" name="Refine plan with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"
                   name="Send additional requirements to architect"
                   messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" name="Receive revised draft from architect"
                      messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from the plan"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order categorized materials from online stores"
                   messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart" name="Order processing and messages to friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OrderProcessed" name="Materials order processed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderProcessed"
                                   messageRef="Message_OrderComplete"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" name="Message friends to build the house"
                   messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Order processed and friends messaged"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations"
                   messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AttendeeListCreated" name="Party attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_WantToBuild" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Send" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDraft_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_PlanReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanNeedsRefinement" name="Plan needs refinement"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PlanReady" targetRef="Task_RefinePlan">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">planNeedsFurtherRefinement</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanReady" name="Plan is ready"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_PlanReady" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_SendAdditional" sourceRef="Task_RefinePlan" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveRevised"
                       sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveRevised_Gateway"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRevisedDraft" targetRef="Gateway_PlanReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_ParallelStart" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelStart_OrderProcessed"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelStart_Friends"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderProcessed_ParallelJoin"
                       sourceRef="Event_OrderProcessed" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Friends_ParallelJoin"
                       sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Invite" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
